tasks.goal: Tighten orphan preflight ownership correlation. Require the exact port lease owner PID to equal the RuntimeManifest owner PID before any service can be safe_to_reap. A dead or live mismatched lease owner must be needs_human and must preserve the process group, lease and manifest. Add a new focused test file covering equal-owner safe classification plus dead and live different-owner rejections, without modifying existing shared runtime test files.

Add optional runtimeId to RuntimeRecoveryRecord for backward compatibility, populate it on every new executor record, and persist it in runtime manifests. Do not derive it from reason strings. Add a new focused test file that verifies reaped, skipped and needs_human records carry runtimeId and old records without it remain readable.

Eliminate concurrent test-file port overlap. Add tests/test-port-ranges.ts with disjoint static pools for runtime-ports, runtime-manager, runtime-manager-identity, runtime-reaper-plan, runtime-reaper, and supervisor-runtime-reaper. Replace each file's ephemeral-port-plus-range helper with the shared pool while preserving expected range assertions. The pools must not overlap the existing runtime-verifier ranges. Run the full suite five consecutive times and leave no fixture listeners.
nonGoals: No changes to reaper safety rules
